keywords.name: Rush
keywords.description: Can attack the turn it is played.

keywords.name: Guard
keywords.description: When an enemy attacks an empty lane next to this creature, this creature blocks instead of your Hero.

keywords.name: Ranged
keywords.description: Ignores Guard, and takes no damage from Thorns or Counter.

keywords.name: Lifesteal
keywords.description: Combat damage this creature deals also heals your Hero.

keywords.name: Thorns
keywords.description: When attacked, deals X damage to the attacker, even if this creature is destroyed.

keywords.name: Counter
keywords.description: When attacked and it survives, strikes back with its full ATK.

keywords.name: Shield
keywords.description: Blocks the next damage completely, then breaks.

keywords.name: Poison
keywords.description: Creatures damaged by this one are poisoned for X. A poisoned creature takes that much damage at the start of its owner's turn, then the poison drops by 1.

keywords.name: Regenerate
keywords.description: Heals X damage at the start of your turn.

keywords.name: Swift
keywords.description: Moving this creature costs no MP.

keywords.name: Stealth
keywords.description: Your opponent cannot target it with spells or abilities until it attacks.

keywords.name: Feast
keywords.description: Heals X damage whenever it destroys a creature in combat.

statuses.name: Frozen
statuses.description: Cannot attack or floop. Thaws at the end of its owner's turn.

statuses.name: Flipped
statuses.description: This landscape counts as no type and cannot receive new cards. It returns at the end of its owner's next turn.

triggers.name: On Play
triggers.description: Happens when this card is played.

triggers.name: On Destroy
triggers.description: Happens when this creature is destroyed.

triggers.name: Start of Turn
triggers.description: Happens at the start of your turn.

triggers.name: End of Turn
triggers.description: Happens at the end of your turn.

triggers.name: On Attack
triggers.description: Happens when this creature attacks, before damage.

triggers.name: When Damaged
triggers.description: Happens when this creature takes damage and survives.

triggers.name: Ally Played
triggers.description: Happens when you play another creature.

triggers.name: Ally Destroyed
triggers.description: Happens when another of your creatures is destroyed.

triggers.name: Enemy Destroyed
triggers.description: Happens when an enemy creature is destroyed.

triggers.name: Spell Cast
triggers.description: Happens when you cast a spell.
